text.p: Tropical Cyclone 08B, with 65 mph winds, is in the Bay of Bengal, moving to the west, and is expected to make landfall in Andhra Pradesh, India, in about 12-24 hours, with top winds near 75 mph. This system will likely producing heavy rains, flash floods, and local wind damage.

Tropical Cyclone 08S is only a moderate threat to shipping in the South Indian Ocean well northeast of Madagascar, moving west southwest. Top winds are 40 mph but are expected to increase as the storm moves southwestward through the period. It may threaten Madagascar, Reunion or Mauritius in a few days. Top winds should be near 75 mph by 48 hours. TC 08S will become an increasing threat to shipping in the region this period.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY STATEMENTS AT THIS TIME
